mechanism_narrative: Higher CPIAUCSL values (as of t-1mo) indicate elevated inflation, which compresses real equity valuations through higher discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL is above its 12-month median, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A UNRATE below 3.5% in the prior month signals a tight labor market, which supports corporate profit growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in HOUST and INDPRO signals a weakening demand environment, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and INDPRO decline, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and rising), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns due to higher discount rates and reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances during FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in INDPRO below its 3-month moving average indicates weakening industrial activity, which reduces corporate earnings growth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 3-month moving average, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in RSAFS above its 12-month average signals strong consumer demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when RSAFS > 12-month average, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in INDPRO below 105.0 (as of t-2mo) indicates industrial contraction, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 105.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A PAYEMS growth rate above 200 (thousand persons) signals strong labor market expansion, which supports consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 200, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
